purpose: Bind portable local-cache keys and bounded setup notes without publishing machine-local paths.

bounded_environment_notes: No admitted lineage may be published unless the source terms pass the pre-outcome license gate.
Parent-declared dependencies may be prepared before network-disabled probe execution.
Browser services are not assumed; every executable relation must declare its local dependency boundary.
Container or virtual-machine tasks are inapplicable unless the frozen command can run inside the local budget.
Dataset downloads and model calls are forbidden during the deterministic evaluator probe.
Only deterministic local evaluator surfaces are eligible for execution.
External model providers and benchmark asset downloads are forbidden during probe execution.
Emulator-dependent relations must use a deterministic local substitute or be recorded as an execution failure.
External model providers are forbidden; only local scorer and transcript contracts are eligible.
Remote inference and large benchmark downloads are forbidden during deterministic probe execution.
Live websites are not assumed; only parent-visible deterministic evaluator contracts are eligible.
